en.headline: Kwun Tong grandmother jailed 20 days for slapping five-year-old
en.dek: Leung Lai-ha, 68, admitted assaulting a girl at APM mall after a basketball dispute involving her grandson and was sentenced by the magistrate on Thursday.
body: A 68-year-old woman was sentenced to 20 days’ imprisonment and fined HK$3,000 on Thursday after pleading guilty to assaulting a five-year-old girl during a dispute at the APM shopping centre in Kwun Tong.

Leung Lai-ha admitted hitting the child on 26 August after the girl and Leung’s grandson argued over a basketball in the mall atrium. A video of the incident showed three adults involved in a physical altercation that escalated when the girl was knocked to the floor.

Acting Principal Magistrate Li Chi-ho told the court that anger should not be taken out on children and that a prison sentence was unavoidable. Leung’s 34-year-old daughter Ng Ka-wun and the girl’s mother, 34-year-old Xu Yang, were each bound over in the sum of HK$1,000 to keep the peace for 12 months after fighting charges against them were withdrawn.
Police and the court recorded that the three adults had not known one another before the incident. The case was heard at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts.

zh.headline: 觀塘APM商場婆婆搶五歲女童判監20日
zh.dek: 68歲梁麗霞承認在孫兒與女童爭籃球後襲擊對方，周四被裁判官判監20日兼罰款3000元。
body: 一名68歲女子周四在觀塘裁判法院承認普通襲擊罪名，被判監禁20日及罰款3000元。案情指她於8月26日在觀塘APM商場中庭，因孫兒與一名五歲女童爭奪籃球而動手打女童。
被告梁麗霞在庭上承認一時衝動打人。現場影片顯示三名成年人捲入爭執，其後女童被推倒在地。裁判官李志豪指出，不應將怒氣發洩在小朋友身上，判監實屬無可避免。
梁的34歲女兒吳家媛及女童母親、34歲的許陽，兩人面對的公眾地方打鬥控罪被撤銷，各自被勒令以1000元擔保守行為12個月。
警方及法庭記錄指，三名涉案成年人事前並不相識。事件在觀塘裁判法院審理。
